title: D3：固定传输预算下的语义引导目标增强通信
current_authorization: Prepare a finite experiment protocol and budget-feasibility plan; static accounting and documentation only. Do not launch new codec, inference, training, payload compression or system reconstruction in this turn.
precedence: For future D3 only. Preserve D0-D2.3 evidence. D2 closes without a semantic-benefit claim; do not resume 011-specific segmentation repair. Earlier D3 training placeholder is superseded.
hypothesis: At comparable complete transmission bytes, semantic region selection improves important-target reconstruction beyond ordinary GLC and a fixed strong nonsemantic region selector.

routes.single_stream_semantic_bit_allocation: alternative for later separate design if the tested dual-stream candidates lack a usable budget-quality point

application_budget.new_clip_S0: ordinary unmodified-source GLC at the fixed 512x288 delivery canvas, q0, original timeline; measured and frozen before enhancement results
application_budget.new_clip_anchor_over_40kbps: retain S0; absolute cap still applies; allow the same lower-resolution ordinary candidates as the dual-stream base; no anchor inflation after outcomes
application_budget.counts: base glcv, enhancement payload, coordinates/timing/lengths, envelope and required checksums or per-clip model/config data
application_budget.network_wire_bytes: report separately; measured application bytes are not acoustic-link feasibility or wire-rate acceptance

representation.aspect_policy: preserve aspect ratio with deterministic letterboxing for non-16:9 sources; original-rate timeline remains intact
representation.base_upsample: fixed Pillow LANCZOS to the common canvas; record version; all comparisons use the same original canvas reference

ROI.lookahead: up to 8 source frames; report buffering delay

representation.full_second_GLC_stream: static format lower bound only in phase1; no encoding allocated under application40

residual_candidate.definition: source RGB minus sender-locally-decoded-and-upsampled base RGB, inside one ROI per block
residual_candidate.rounding: integer nearest with ties away from zero
residual_candidate.temporal: first quantized residual then adjacent-frame differences within each block; reset at each block
residual_candidate.serialization: signed little-endian int16 in T,H,W,C order; zlib level6 per block including its own header/checksum
residual_candidate.receiver: reconstruct every frame Q, residual=Q*quant_step; d=min(local_x,local_y,w-1-local_x,h-1-local_y); correction=round_ties_away_from_zero(residual*min(4,d)/4); add to independently decoded base, clamp to uint8
residual_candidate.zero_block: record retained, payload_len=0 allowed only when every quantized residual value is zero; means zero correction
residual_candidate.scope: one deliberately simple coder, not an optimum or a lower bound on all enhancement coding

envelope.status: layout proposal only; future actual serialized byte count is authoritative

methods.D3_A: ordinary GLC, same canvas/timeline and resolution choices, allowed the complete total budget
methods.D3_B: same base/residual/ROI area and update cadence as C; fixed source-only camera-translation-compensated motion selector, texture tie-break, never random deliberately weak boxes
methods.D3_C: same transmission mechanism; fixed existing predictor selects ROI; no threshold search or 011-specific repair
methods.D3_D_GT: same mechanism; maximize GT target pixels in ROI as a localization diagnostic, not deployment evidence or guaranteed optimal bound

selectors.common_grid: 128x96 rectangles on 8px top-left grid within512x288; add last valid edge position; ties topmost then leftmost
selectors.B: pool absolute grayscale temporal differences over the8-frame block after global integer translation compensation by phase correlation; compensation estimates larger than32px use uncompensated differences and are flagged; equal motion scores choose larger summed gradient then grid order
selectors.B_freeze: exact implementation and source-only deterministic checks frozen before enhancement results; no tuning against C, GT or reconstructed quality
selectors.C: fish probability>=0.5 from existing base native tiles512/stride384; diver existing longedge256 argmax-class1 and probability>=0.5; resize class membership to canvas NEAREST and pool target membership over block; no D2 dilation/history/fallback gate
selectors.C_no_detection: use the same B selection and disclose each fallback block; entirely fallback clips cannot count as semantic-selection wins
selectors.D_GT: pool target-mask pixels over block on same grid; GT never reaches A/B/C selector or independent receiver
selectors.evaluation_denominator: all annotated targets including misses and objects outside chosen ROI

phases.task: protocol, source roster, old metadata and format arithmetic
future finite budget probes on up to4 development clips
optional single80kbps diagnostic batch on011/021; per clip choose highest q0 base size with a byte-fitting GT point, reuse GT payloads; B gets the same base and3 quant steps
one eligible GT package end-to-end in an isolated receiver using received bytes only
development A/B/GT mechanism comparison first; only a matched positive mechanism permits C. Finish development before one-shot007 A/B/C/GT confirmation. At most5 registered clips.

whole_plan_ceiling.meaning: worst-case sum across conditional separately dispatched phases, never an instruction to launch one matrix; reused completed points are not rerun

rate_matching.A: reuse compatible actual points; probe q0 at3 base sizes, then at most2 new q points per clip at the largest size whose q0 fits the relevant ceiling; choose from measured sizes only
rate_matching.A_next_q: reuse run_d2_lowrate.next_q size-only log interpolation (.016 initial slope), unique integers0..63, max2 new points; no monotonicity assumption for final selection
rate_matching.H_A: at most q32 and q63 at512x288 per diagnostic clip, reuse if already encoded compatibly
rate_matching.enhancement: q0 base only; quant steps8,16,32; never add per-clip steps or geometry after results; choose measured admissible size closest below comparator target, then smaller quant step, then larger base on exact ties
rate_matching.common_base_freeze: from D3.1 choose the highest base size having a byte-fitting GT candidate on at least2 of3 registered fish-development clips; visual viability required before prototype; record diver viability separately; freeze globally for B/C/D before their quality results
rate_matching.B_A_selection: each gets largest measured admissible total file below its phase ceiling; choose without decoded-quality/GT-quality scores; D3_C and D3_D_GT target min(selected A bytes, selected B bytes)
rate_matching.unmatched: insufficient size matching; report exact points and differences; no padding/interpolation/fake stream/automatic new search and no equal-byte semantic claim

evaluation.primary_question: Can predicted semantic selection produce a target benefit beyond both matched A and B?
evaluation.visual: same source-reference view, scale, timeline and fixed crops; record clearer/tie/worse, true detail, identifiable targets, contour, flicker, ghosts, seams and global scene usability; single-user results exploratory
evaluation.numeric: per-clip pooled target RGB MSE/PSNR, rest-of-image MSE/PSNR, fixed GT inner-boundary gradient error; temporal reconstruction-error change on the union of adjacent-frame GT targets; raw edge sharpness is not fidelity
evaluation.task: fixed source-vs-decoded recognizability/trajectory-continuity worksheet first; reuse an independently assessed frozen task model only if it can evaluate originals meaningfully; report its original-input ceiling and GT metrics separately; unimplemented or unlabeled metrics are NA
evaluation.mechanism: GT beating matched A/B suggests potential only for this mechanism and cases; no deployment claim
evaluation.provisional_semantic_positive: C strictly size-matched to both A/B and judged clearer than both on at least2 of3 registered fish-development clips, with genuine source-consistent detail and no new severe temporal/global artifacts on those clips; disclose all other losses and numerical disagreements
evaluation.007: one-shot sequence confirmation only after rules frozen; failure prevents broader confirmation claim, does not trigger tuning
evaluation.diver: separate required evidence for a fish-and-diver claim; pending diver slot blocks that claim, not truthful fish-only findings
evaluation.claims: scope to tested clips and this nonsemantic control; not proof that every nonsemantic alternative is inferior or that source-independent generalization holds

stop_conditions: Current turn ends after protocol, static accounting, verification, handoff and commit/push; no experiment dispatch.
No usable budget-quality point on at least2 of3 fish-development clips: close this candidate's application40 pilot;011 alone does not veto the route.
Base plus enhancement fails scene usability or introduces severe temporal artifacts: byte fit alone is not a pass.
Complete GT mechanism fails matched A/B: do not invest in predictor training or rollout; restrict conclusion to tested candidates and matching status.
B matches C: attribute benefit to region enhancement/resource allocation, not demonstrated semantic selection.
Only80kbps works: mechanism diagnostic only, application target failed; do not refreeze S0 or relax application limits.
Budget, point count, input limit, decode integrity or source-access boundary fails: preserve artifacts and stop the affected phase; no silent expansion.
Single-stream internal bit allocation remains a later design candidate, never automatically implemented after failure.
